posts.name: The Conscience
posts.cooked:
Hey all,

I am going to the con of cons and have run into an issue of sleepy-time rest space. In other words does anyone one have a hotel/motel I can crash in for the con? I would be willing to pay a small fee for the luxury of takin up a small amount of space on the floor. 

I did have plans previously but they fell thru and I find with the con so close now I have to scramble to get space for me to lay down my weary head.

Any help you can provide would be greatly appreciated.

James
